raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly assumed the first place named in the NIV Book of Esther was Susa and switched the target to Iran without verifying the text. In Esther 1:1 (NIV), the first place named is India (followed by Cush); Susa appears later (1:2). This led the workflow to look up Iran’s prime minister instead of India’s, producing the wrong final answer (it should have targeted India’s PM in April 1977, Morarji Desai).
